decision.justification: Candidate C achieves the lowest validation RMSE (0.6545) and shows the most stable performance across the three validation windows, indicating robustness to the unstable model ranking observed in the diagnostics. Using the full model pool allows the mean to average out idiosyncratic errors while still benefiting from the diverse set of well‑performing models (THETA, ETS, CWT_rf, etc.).
